name: opentelemetry-contribution-metrics
description: Visualization tool for tracking OpenTelemetry contributions by language

scripts.fetch-merged-prs: node scripts/fetch/fetch_merged_prs.js && python3 scripts/processing/merged_prs_to_csv.py && python3 scripts/processing/plot.py --source=merged
scripts.fetch-coverage: node scripts/fetch/fetch_coverage.js && python3 scripts/processing/coverage_to_csv.py && python3 scripts/processing/plot.py --source=coverage-snapshot
scripts.fetch-pr-flow: node scripts/fetch/fetch_pr_flow.js && python3 scripts/processing/pr_flow_to_csv.py --only=time-to-merge && python3 scripts/processing/plot.py --source=time-to-merge
